title: 6-Month Contract for Sulfuric Acid

onscreen_lines.desc: Cost per ton for shipments of approximately 25 tons for sulfuric acid, 66 degrees BE, to be delivered to the City of Ames Power Plant as requested by the City during the contract period of November 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027.
onscreen_lines.note: All prices are to be quoted FOB Destination with full freight and/or delivery charges allowed. Any additional fees must be listed in the notes.
